database_meta.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Digitized Compliance Rule Database
database_meta.primary_source: GSR 202(E) dated 07-03-2011, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, effective 01-04-2011
database_meta.disclaimer: This database was compiled from the original 2011 gazette notification text and publicly available legal-commentary summaries of subsequent amendment notifications. Rule numbering for clauses added after 2011 (e.g. e-commerce declarations, unit sale price, combination/group packages) has shifted across several amendments. Before production deployment, cross-verify every rule_reference and threshold value against the current consolidated text published by the Department of Consumer Affairs / e-Gazette, and re-confirm with legal counsel. Treat this file as a first working draft of the rule engine's data layer, not a legal authority.
database_meta.schema_notes: Each rule object maps to one automated check in the compliance engine. 'validation_logic.type' tells the engine which checker module to invoke (presence_check, format_regex, numeral_height_check, font_height_check, spacing_check, enum_check).

mandatory_declarations.title: Name and address of manufacturer / packer / importer
mandatory_declarations.requirement: Every package must state the name and complete address of the manufacturer; if the manufacturer is not the packer, both manufacturer and packer name/address; for imported packages, the name and address of the importer.
exemptions: Food articles (governed instead by FSSAI labelling rules)
Packages of capacity 5 cubic cm or less (mark/inscription sufficient)

validation_logic.notes: OCR block must contain a resolvable name + postal address (street/PIN).

mandatory_declarations.title: Common or generic name of the commodity
mandatory_declarations.requirement: The common/generic name of the commodity must be declared; if a package contains more than one product, the name and quantity/number of each must be stated.

mandatory_declarations.title: Net quantity declaration
mandatory_declarations.requirement: Net quantity in standard unit of weight/measure, or number of items if sold by count, excluding packaging/wrapper weight.

validation_logic.notes: Reject non-SI units (e.g. dozen, score, gross) per Rule 13(4); flag qualifying words like 'minimum'/'about'/'approx' per Rule 12(6).

mandatory_declarations.title: Month and year of manufacture / pre-packing / import
mandatory_declarations.requirement: Month and year the commodity was manufactured, pre-packed, or imported.
exemptions: Domestic LPG cylinders (14.2kg/5kg) marketed by PSUs
Spare parts/accessories used for servicing under warranty, not sold to end customer (added 2023 amendment)

amended_by.change: Added exemption for warranty spare parts/accessories not sold to end customer; clarified that for electronic products this date must be clearly visible on the retail package.

mandatory_declarations.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP), inclusive of all taxes
mandatory_declarations.requirement: Retail sale price must be printed as 'Maximum Retail Price Rs. ... inclusive of all taxes' or 'MRP Rs. ... incl. of all taxes', with paise rounding: below 50 paise rounded down to preceding rupee, 50-95 paise rounded to 50 paise.
exemptions: Domestic LPG cylinders priced under the Administrative Price Mechanism
Alcoholic beverages/spirituous liquor (governed by State Excise laws unless those laws are silent, in which case this rule applies)

validation_logic.notes: Flag missing 'inclusive of all taxes' qualifier and incorrect paise rounding.

mandatory_declarations.title: Dimensions of commodity (where size is relevant)
mandatory_declarations.requirement: Where size/dimensions of the commodity are relevant to the sale, dimensions must be declared; if pieces differ in size, each must be stated.

mandatory_declarations.title: Consumer/customer care details
mandatory_declarations.requirement: Name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address (if available) of the person/office that can be contacted for consumer complaints.

mandatory_declarations.title: Country of origin (imported products)
mandatory_declarations.requirement: Imported packages must declare the country of origin/manufacture/assembly.
mandatory_declarations.in_force_since: amendment period 2017-2018 (exact clause number to be confirmed against consolidated text)

mandatory_declarations.title: Mandatory declarations on e-commerce product listings
mandatory_declarations.requirement: Goods displayed for sale on digital/e-commerce platforms must carry the same mandatory declarations as physical retail packages (manufacturer/packer/importer, generic name, net quantity, MRP, month/year, consumer care) on the listing page itself.

amended_by.change: Added Rule 26(g) exemption for loose commodities ordered through e-commerce channels where the consumer is aware of type/quantity, provided the listing still bears name/address of responsible entity with country of origin, and net quantity.

validation_logic.notes: Applies to product description/listing text extraction, not just package image.

mandatory_declarations.title: Unit sale price (per standard unit)
mandatory_declarations.requirement: Declare unit sale price in rupees, rounded to nearest two decimal places: per gram (net qty < 1kg) or per kg (>1kg); per cm (length < 1m) or per metre (>1m); per ml (volume <1l) or per litre (>1l); per number/unit for count-based items.
exemptions: Packages where retail sale price equals unit sale price
Alcoholic beverages/spirituous liquor governed by State Excise law
mandatory_declarations.in_force_since: 2023-01-01 (effective date pushed back multiple times: originally 01-04-2022, then 01-10-2022, 01-12-2022, finally 01-01-2023)

amended_by.change: Extended combination/grouped-package compliance; delayed effective date to 01-10-2022
Delayed effective date to 01-12-2022; enabled QR-code disclosure option for electronic devices
Final effective date fixed at 01-01-2023 in some notifications / 01-06-2023 in others - confirm final date against gazette

validation_logic.notes: Cross-check unit_sale_price times net_quantity approx equals MRP within rounding tolerance.

mandatory_declarations.rule_reference: Rule 6(1) (Second Schedule references omitted by 2023 amendment)
mandatory_declarations.title: Standard package quantities for specified commodities
mandatory_declarations.requirement: [HISTORICAL - omitted 01-01-2024] Certain commodities (baby food, biscuits, bread, butter, cereals, coffee, tea, edible oil, milk powder, detergents, atta/rawa/suji, salt, soaps, aerated drinks, mineral water, cement, paints) were required to be packed only in specified standard quantities per the Second Schedule.

amended_by.change: Second Schedule (standard package sizes) omitted entirely - manufacturers may now use any pack size, subject to other declaration requirements.

validation_logic.notes: Retain for historical audit only; do not flag non-standard pack sizes for products dated on/after 2024-01-01.

general_letter_height.requirement: Height of letters in any declaration shall not be less than 1 mm; where the declaration is blown, formed, molded, embossed or perforated, height shall not be less than 2 mm. Width of any letter/numeral shall not be less than one-third of its height (except numeral '1' and letters i, I, l).

numeral_height_by_weight_or_volume.requirement: Minimum height of numerals in the net quantity declaration, when net quantity is declared by weight or volume.

numeral_height_by_length_area_or_number.requirement: Minimum height of numerals in the net quantity declaration, when quantity is declared by length, area, or number - keyed to the area of the principal display panel.

validation_logic.notes: Requires computer-vision estimate of PDP area from the image plus a calibration reference (coin/ruler) to convert pixel height to mm.

advertisement_font_parity.requirement: In any advertisement stating the retail sale price, the font size of the net quantity declaration must be the same as that of the retail sale price.

placement_and_manner_rules.title: All declarations on principal display panel
placement_and_manner_rules.requirement: Every declaration must appear on the Principal Display Panel (PDP), either fully grouped in one place, or with pre-printed info grouped in one place and on-line/variable info grouped in another.

validation_logic.notes: Detected declaration text-regions should fall within the identified PDP bounding box.

placement_and_manner_rules.title: Clear space around net quantity declaration
placement_and_manner_rules.requirement: The area surrounding the net quantity declaration must be free of other printed information: above and below by at least the height of the numeral used; to the left and right by at least twice that height.

placement_and_manner_rules.title: Legible, prominent, contrasting declarations
placement_and_manner_rules.requirement: Declarations must be legible and prominent; numerals of MRP and net quantity must be printed/painted/inscribed in a colour that contrasts conspicuously with the label background (except where blown/formed/molded on glass/plastic, or where hand-written but clear and unambiguous).

validation_logic.notes: WCAG-style contrast ratio used as an engineering proxy; not itself a statutory numeric threshold - calibrate against enforcement precedent.

placement_and_manner_rules.title: No declaration readable only through liquid
placement_and_manner_rules.requirement: A declaration must not be positioned such that it can only be read through a liquid commodity inside the package.

validation_logic.notes: Difficult to automate reliably; flag for human review when liquid product plus declaration appears to sit behind fill line.

placement_and_manner_rules.title: Language requirement
placement_and_manner_rules.requirement: Declarations must be in Hindi (Devanagari script) or English; other languages may be used in addition, not instead.

placement_and_manner_rules.title: No individual stickers altering mandatory declarations
placement_and_manner_rules.requirement: Stickers may not be affixed to alter/make a mandatory declaration, except a sticker reducing MRP (which must not cover the original MRP declaration). Stickers may be used for non-mandatory declarations.

validation_logic.notes: Detect sticker/overlay regions via edge/texture discontinuity over MRP or other mandatory fields; flag for manual review.

wholesale_package_rules.title: Wholesale package declarations
wholesale_package_rules.requirement: Every wholesale package must declare: (a) name and address of manufacturer/importer/packer, (b) identity of the commodity, (c) total number of retail packages contained, or net quantity of the commodity in standard units.

exemptions.condition: Package net quantity greater than 25 kg / 25 litre (or up to 50 kg for cement/fertilizer bags)
exemptions.effect: Chapter II (retail package declarations) does not apply.

exemptions.condition: Commodity intended for industrial or institutional consumers
Net weight/measure 10 g or 10 ml or less
exemptions.effect: Fully exempt (MRP and net quantity still required for the 10-20 g/ml band per subsequent proviso).

exemptions.condition: Scheduled/non-scheduled drug formulations under Drugs (Price Control) Order, 1995
Agricultural farm produce in packages above 50 kg

exemptions.rule_reference: Rule 26(g) - added by LMPC (Amendment) Rules, 2023, effective 2024-01-01
exemptions.condition: Loose commodities ordered through e-commerce where consumer is aware of type/quantity
exemptions.effect: Exempt from full Chapter II, but must still bear name/address (with country of origin if imported) and net quantity.

penalty_reference.violation: Contravention of any other rule with no penalty prescribed elsewhere

penalty_reference.rule_reference: Legal Metrology Act 2009, relevant sections (confirm exact section numbers)
penalty_reference.violation: Sale of non-standard packages / incorrect quantity declarations
penalty_reference.penalty: Fines escalating with repeat offences; imprisonment possible for repeat/serious offences - confirm against Act text before use in report generation.

amendment_history.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (original notification)
amendment_history.summary: Base rules established: Chapters on retail packages, wholesale packages, export/import, exemptions, registration, general provisions; First-Seventh Schedules.
Extended time period for exhausting old packaging material without correction.

Withdrew non-standard-pack-size declaration proviso and rubber-stamp month/year proviso; amended Rule 12(6) wording on misleading quantity words; changed ice cream unit of measure from volume to weight (Fourth Schedule); amended Rule 19(8) wording on release of seized packages.
Extended mandatory declarations to goods sold via e-commerce/digital platforms.
Introduced unit sale price declaration requirement alongside MRP.
Added compliance requirement for grouped/combination retail packages; reinforced unit price declaration in INR.
Permitted QR-code disclosure of descriptive/elaborative information for electronic devices, with key information still printed on the device/package.

amendment_history.effective_from: deferred to 2023-06-01 (later notifications reference 2023-07-01 / 2023-01-01 - reconcile with gazette)
amendment_history.summary: Further deferred effective date of unit sale price / grouped package provisions; garment/hosiery sold loose exempted.
Omitted the Second Schedule (standard package sizes) entirely.

amendment_history.instrument: LMPC (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2023 (main substantive amendment)
amendment_history.summary: Introduced defined terms 'combination package', 'group package', 'multi-piece package'; amended Rule 6(1)(d) to exempt warranty spare parts/accessories from month-year declaration and to require visible month-year for electronic products; amended Rule 26 to add exemption (g) for loose e-commerce commodities; amendments to Fourth Schedule for edible oil, vanaspati, butter oil.

maximum_permissible_error_reference.note: Not a label-declaration check, but useful if the system is later extended to weight-verification workflows (out of scope for pure image/label scanning).
